alt: Patient communication documenting financial damages (out-of-pocket Lyft expenses) due to NEMT refusal, Ombudsman inaction, and the official denial of an Expedited State Hearing by the CDSS.
full_text:
Hope your ride works out. Thanks for the heads up for your payment. You will start getting automatic messages after the missed payment, but no need to actually reply to the auto messages. [Name redacted] NP

Hi [Name redacted], I was finally able to get a ride last night (had to pay for a Lyft). I contacted the Ombudsman offie and as usual they documented the situation and kicked the can down the road. Quick update - my credit card is currently maxed out (actually over the limit now, I know about the 30 day grace we discussed but that's not my style...although I really appreciate it) and my expedited state hearing request against L.A. Care (SHN-[redacted]96) was denied yesterday (04/14/2026)
summary: Patient communication documenting financial damages (out-of-pocket Lyft expenses) due to NEMT refusal, Ombudsman inaction, and the official denial of an Expedited State Hearing by the CDSS.
